key_insight: MultiAlloc allocates a fixed KV-cache memory budget across layer-wise precision and token-wise preservation to improve quantization quality without online search.
engineering_relevance: It provides a practical, profiling-driven way to reduce LLM inference memory while preserving accuracy for long-context and reasoning workloads.
method: Lightweight offline profiling measures layer sensitivity and token importance.
The profiler estimates the memory–accuracy trade-off under a fixed budget.
An allocation policy is derived once and applied during inference, avoiding online search.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent gains over layer-wise, token-wise, and recent multi-granularity KV-cache quantization methods on reasoning and long-context benchmarks across Mistral, Llama, DeepSeek-Qwen, and QwQ.
watch_item: The approach depends on offline profiling being representative of the target model and workload, so mismatches in deployment data could reduce gains.
paper_title: MultiAlloc: Budget-Aware Precision Allocation for KV Cache Quantization
